claim: One w:rPr may state a property more than once, and the last statement is the one that resolves.

sources.locator: wml.xsd group EG_RPrBase is an xsd:choice, and CT_RPr, CT_ParaRPr, CT_RPrOriginal and CT_ParaRPrOriginal all reference it minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded", verified in specifications/generated/docx-transitional-schema.gen.json. The repeat is therefore valid markup, and no clause says which statement wins.

44 of 5299 packages hold a w:rPr with a repeated child in word/document.xml or word/styles.xml, almost all written by LibreOffice; w:b, w:i and w:sz are the names that repeat. 3131 of the 3132 repeats state the same value twice. The one that disagrees is <w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz w:val="26"/> on an Arabic run whose w:szCs is 26, so the later statement is the size that was meant.

fixtures.assertion: The run is not bold and its size is 26: each property resolves to its last statement, and a save writes each one once.
